purpose: A bounded new acoustic development set exercising incomplete pauses, disfluency repair, place ambiguity/clarification and voice versus non-speech during result playback, with slow transcript delivery separated from naturally slow inference.

independence.authorship: New wording, acoustic combinations, case labels and outcome criteria specified here before any new rendering or live outcome. Entities come from the existing simulated map, not benchmark answer files.
independence.exposure: Map semantics and some place names already appear in unit tests; prior airport/office acoustic cases and SDK/probe results informed this design. This is independently composed development input, not untouched held-out data or unseen-domain generalization.
independence.labels: No live results, VAD characterization, offline ASR output or preferred pronunciation may be used to select or rewrite inputs in this version.

recommended_scope.repeated_data_limit: Matched probe waveforms and reused pause stems are dependent observations; no population p95 or confidence claim.
recommended_scope.paired_fix_comparison: If claiming the root interruption fix helps, additionally replay the same eight probe cases on a frozen pre-fix source. Keep before8 and after8 separately matched; the five language cases are candidate-only coverage, not improvement measurements. Total21 captures if both scopes are adopted before launch. This proposal does not request launching either scope.

source_audio_creation.inference: Only existing pinned local Kokoro-82M, voice af_heart, speed1.1; first render each of eight declared spoken stems once. Existing Parakeet snapshot may provide one verbatim offline preparation transcript per final speech asset, without retries/selection; that is not live ASR accuracy.

source_audio_creation.format: Keep first-render mono PCM16 24000Hz WAV bytes and raw stems. No loudness normalization, word splice, selection or extra silence removal for spoken assets. Record sample counts, exact model references, generator source/packages/command/timing and source/output hashes.
source_audio_creation.pause_assembly: Concatenate the exact same untrimmed pause_prefix PCM, exactly6000 or28800 zero samples, then the same metro_tail PCM. Preserve both stems. Labels describe inserted silence250/1200ms, not actual total acoustic gap; retain measured last-active-prefix to first-active-tail interval and all final segments.

controls.formula: NumPy Generator(PCG64(1802)) standard_normal float64; rFFT retain300–3400Hz inclusive, other bins zero; inverse rFFT; multiply20ms linear onset/offset ramps; normalize global RMS to-24dBFS after ramps; np.rint toPCM16. Record library version, peak, clipping count and SHA.

NumPy Generator(PCG64(1803)) standard_normal float64; rFFT retain500–6000Hz inclusive; inverse rFFT; raised-cosine attack180ms and decay720ms; normalize global RMS to-24dBFS after envelope; np.rint toPCM16. Record library version, peak, clipping count and SHA.
controls.label_limit: Artificial shaped noise only, not a real human breath, cough, road recording or microphone echo.

source_audio_creation.clipping_policy: If normalized control exceeds int16 range, retain generation failure; do not silently clip, change seed or rerender until VAD responds. Amend a new protocol before any replacement.
source_audio_creation.vad_preparation: Optional one frozen offline VAD characterization of every probe, with no input selection or gain tuning. Every declared stimulus remains in RTC even when VAD never triggers. No non-speech waveform duration/RMS proves model activation.

navigation_effect_contract.required_chain: A fresh compute_route for the declared place followed by start_navigation referencing that computation; search_destination is optional. Retain every read, retry, rejected plan and physical attempt; do not hardcode three attempts.
navigation_effect_contract.route_identity: Require the successful start to reference its own fresh computed route; do not assume a literal route ID from a counter.
navigation_effect_contract.no_extra_effects: No add_waypoint, extra start, cancel or unrelated write. Backend errors are not successful mutations.

numeric_expectation_derivation.method: Read PLACES using ast.literal_eval only, independently calculate existing haversine*ROAD_FACTOR1.35 and max(1,round(km/24*60)); no car-tool imports, tests or model calls. All begin at P_HOME.
numeric_expectation_derivation.limits: These are simulated-source expectations. Freeze/recheck them if source changes; generated speech must be compared against actual successful returned values as well.

slow_recognition_condition.purpose: Deterministic stress for delayed final text delivery while VAD/RTC keep running; not a claim that cache pressure caused historical delays.
slow_recognition_condition.recommended_injection: Experiment-only wrapper around LocalSTT._recognize_impl: await original with unchanged args; record native completion; await an ordinary cancellable asyncio.sleep(5.0); return the original unmodified SpeechEvent. Apply to every recognition in each delay-condition room, including initial input and empty results; no text, asset-hash or expected-answer selection. Do not delay blocking warmup or change model inference/cache/turn thresholds.
measurements: actual engine/queue stages and normalized PCM hash
slow_recognition_condition.fidelity: Preserve cancellation and exception identity; do not shield/force delivery after cancellation, occupy the STT worker with sleeping, block the event loop, serialize unrelated rooms differently, or synthesize transcripts. Own/restore wrapper in finally. Whole-span retranscription remains separately recorded and is not silently given the same delay.
slow_recognition_condition.limit: This isolates asynchronous SDK-facing delivery delay, not actual slow native inference, accelerator contention, shared-queue pressure or production capacity. Native0 and injected5 data must never be pooled as natural performance.
slow_recognition_condition.non_speech_gate: Some controls produce no recognition call; then no injected hold occurs. Retain the planned condition and report delay mechanism unexercised for that probe rather than claiming slow-STT false-interruption coverage.

minimal_recorder_additions.proposal: Add an explicit opt-in followup trigger that waits for a fresh matched non-ack response/clarification/result handle to finish and150ms of received quiet before sending the next input. Add an explicit allowed-final-kind set for no-tool reply captures if they are run separately. Keep current result-PCM default and mutual exclusions.
required_guards: source/SDK trust boundary unchanged; blank identity never promoted
intent/final timestamp after preceding input and strictly beyond prior intent
same handle unused for a previous trigger
non-ack actual received PCM and completed handle; no bare acknowledgement
no stale earlier handle or merely queued response
kind/timeouts/trigger evidence and failure stage retained
minimal_recorder_additions.scope: Playback currently tags loud frames only to active_result, so enabling non-ack modes also needs conservative kind-aware PCM association; do not simply relax kind checking globally.

minimal_recorder_additions.proposal: Use existing --probe with --probe-observation-seconds30 for all eight probe captures. Add no production hook solely to make capture finish; the same finite window remains whether the outcome is success, false positive or no response.
minimal_recorder_additions.scope: No recorder addition needed for this mode or single-WAV pauses/disfluency.

minimal_recorder_additions.proposal: If root SDK investigation exposes a stable public agent_false_interruption/resumed event or output pause/resume observation, retain it in experiment-only instrumentation with monotonic timestamp and speech ID. Preserve current server/raw telemetry and limits.
minimal_recorder_additions.scope: Without explicit observation, same-handle/listening→speaking/PCM continuation supports inferred resumption only, not a directly observed SDK classification.

runner_and_audit_gaps: The frozen14–17 runner/audits expect cancel/repeat workloads and specific turn/effect inventories. Do not run the new cases through them unchanged or call their hardcoded checks authoritative. A new frozen harness must honor case-specific --probe versus followup mode and preserve all unrun/failed rows.

Do not require exactly one USER_FINAL per pause WAV; VAD may split spans and retranscription may merge them. Match complete user meaning, observed segmented text and finalized revisions separately, retaining omissions/hallucinations.

Unnecessary clarification must inspect recorded spoken content after a complete uniquely grounded request, not count kind=clarification only: resolver response or tool-error result can ask a question. Exact speech strings are not required; all required destination/state/ETA facts are.

For no-write ambiguity, distinguish permitted read errors/skipped dependencies from actual attempted or successful mutations. Wrong-route starts and premature writes remain failures even if later corrected.

Compute final reply timing from last meaningful user speech end through actual final received non-silent PCM/handle finish; do not equate a result handle flag with timely or physical audible cutoff. Keep late recognition, paused audio, old tail and clarification wait as separate intervals.

measurement_plan.full_denominators: All13 declared captures, all22 publications,15 expected mutations,13 final replies,2 intentional stop interruptions and6 non-speech controls. Report missing/unrun/failure rows and every extra effect/call/clarification beyond those denominators. Exact count is a predeclared target, never a filter.
measurement_plan.input_meaning: Preserve original text/segment recipe and verbatim offline/live transcripts. Primary semantic correctness uses frozen requested places/actions; exact transcript match is secondary. No posthoc spelling whitelist may silently convert an error into a pass. Human proper-name review may be separately labeled.
core_metrics: destination/reference resolution and clarification after complete known requests
input onset→first sustained old-PCM cessation and any later resumption
VAD response, output pause, explicit/inferred resume, irreversible interruption and original facts retained
acknowledgment latency separately from substantive speech
final-input speech-end→effect dispatch and complete final reply
all attempted/reused/error/cancelled/unknown calls and trace equality
measurement_plan.timely_cutoff: Predeclare receipt-level screen threshold1000ms from source activity onset to last attributable old non-silent PCM before at least300ms quiet. Keep continuous values and resumptions; count unmeasurable overlap separately. This is an engineering screen parameter, not a physiological or physical acoustic claim. An interruption_requested handle alone cannot pass.
false_positive_classification: no VAD response: false-effect control only, recovery unexercised
VAD response without observable output pause
pause and same original speech resumes/completes
nonempty unintended STT final/intent and/or extra tool effect
irreversible interruption or missing original required facts
measurement_plan.timing_reporting: Show each value and full denominator. Descriptive nearest-rank p50/p95 only within matched probe conditions; with n1 per new language case and n4 per probe condition do not claim population percentiles, significance or general performance.
measurement_plan.review: After every timed comparison stack is closed, one whole-stream received-ASR pass per capture with no crop/retry/selection; preserve silence and both questions/replies. ASR proxy cannot establish human breath acoustics, intelligibility or physical playback.
measurement_plan.timely_cutoff_applies_to: The two intentional voiced-stop captures only. For non-speech controls, pause latency is descriptive and original speech should resume/finish; continuing speech when VAD never triggers is not a cutoff failure.
